name: Self-Directed Dimension of Blockwise Addressing
proof: Theorem 1 of \cite{devulapalli2024selfdirected} identifies $\mathrm{SDdim}$ with the subset-maximized self-directed mistake bound. The blockwise-addressing value lies between $d$ and $d+1$: a repeated binary block gives the lower bound and majority prediction on the $2^{d+1}$ concepts gives the upper bound. The whole-domain two-mistake strategy does not bound this parameter.
references: \cite{devulapalli2024selfdirected}; derived from the established self-directed-queries-complexity benchmark value
